mapper.sql: SELECT i.*,p.name AS product_name,o.order_number FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND product_id=#{productId}
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(product_name,' × ',quantity) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiries SET ai_state='RUNNING',ai_token=#{token},ai_started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='OPEN' AND (ai_started_at IS NULL OR ai_started_at < #{cooldown}) AND (ai_state <> 'RUNNING' OR ai_started_at < #{expired})
UPDATE inquiries SET ai_state=#{run.state},draft=#{run.draft},needs_review=#{run.needsReview},review_reason=#{run.reason},ai_token=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND ai_token=#{token} AND status='OPEN'
UPDATE inquiries SET ai_state='FAILED',ai_token=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND ai_token=#{token}
